expected.source: trail.research.json official West Sweden Trails API order, stages 1-27

researched.status: all 27 official stages have section research packets

blockedSections.reason: Official WST/Hoodin and Naturkartan geometry is about 4.4 km partial line, but official distance is 14 km and text says the middle is unmarked/self-navigation.

partialOrPolicySections.handoffNote: Stage 8 to Stage 9 has a small official continuity gap of about 49.4 m at Bottenstugan; review before route-chain import rather than silently snapping.
Official WST/Hoodin GPX, Naturkartan and current OSM linework cover only about 4.389 km while the official stage is 14 km.
4.296 km straight-line gap from the Stage 21 WST/Hoodin GPX end to the Stage 22 start; do not stitch automatically.

sourceArtifactsToUse: trail.research.json for official stage order and overview contradictions
sections/*.research.json for stage caveats, facilities, access, rules and do-not-import guidance
mapdata/index.json for geometry metrics, source policy, continuity and blocked-import status
mapdata/sections/*.geojson for one de-duplicated candidate GeoJSON LineString per official stage
mapdata/validation-report.json for parse, shape, source URL and continuity checks
sourceArtifactsToSuppress: mapdata/reference/bohusleden-stage-21-osm-old-unblazed-reference.geojson for import; retain only as old no-longer-blazed reference
OSM relations and route-app tracks when section files mark them QA-only, stale, overlong, endpoint-offset or non-canonical
Legacy Lindome/Blavattnerna southern-start naming except as stale alias risk
transformPolicy: Primary section geometry is WST/Hoodin official GPX, de-duplicated only for consecutive duplicate coordinates.
All generated mapdata uses GeoJSON coordinate order [longitude, latitude].
No simplification, snapping or routing was applied.
Do not create an invented Stage 21 full route from straight lines, automatic routing or stale/unblazed relations.
GPX elevations/timestamps are not reliable for several northern sections; use linework only where section files say elevations are zero/unusable.
endpointContinuityIssues: Stages 1-7 chain exactly or negligibly, then Stage 8 to Stage 9 has a 49.4 m small-known-gap at Bottenstugan.
Stages 9-20 chain exactly or negligibly to Stage 21 start.
Stage 21 to Stage 22 has a 4296.3 m blocking-or-intentional-gap; known Stage 21 partial-geometry/self-navigation gap; do not stitch automatically.
Stages 22-27 chain exactly or negligibly after the Stage 21 gap.
OSM endpoint offsets around Kynnefjalls natur and Vaktarekullen are QA context only; WST/Hoodin remains primary.

blockedGeometry.resolutionRequired: Obtain authoritative full route corridor from Tanum municipality/WST or encode a deliberate partial/self-navigation model. Do not auto-stitch the gap.

dedupeClusterPolicy: Cluster endpoint and same-site facilities before import, especially Delsjobadet/Skatas, Kasjobadet/Jonsered, Bottenstugan, Stenshult, Kaserna, Borgmastarbruket, Harska, KynnefjallsNatur, Vaktarekullen, Flotemarkson/Holmen, Porsas, Krokstrand, Hogstad and Stromstad.
Merge same-site shelter, fireplace, toilet, water, waste, information-board, parking and bathing records where section files describe one cluster.
Keep access connectors, bus stops, train stations, taxi/Nartrafik and parking as access metadata unless the section file marks them route facilities.
Keep commercial/private/staffed services as conditional nearby-service metadata unless verified as public always-available trail service.
suppressOrPendingClasses: Do not import Stage 21 old/unblazed OSM relation as current route or facility spine.
Suppress distant off-route place-feed artifacts unless the app later supports off-route access/service metadata.
Keep OSM-only firepits, water points, shelters and picnic sites pending until verified by official, manager, field or current source evidence.
Do not mark natural waters, lakes, springs or untreated sources as potable.
Do not import closed/unsafe/ruined/private structures as usable shelters or lodging.
highRiskFacilityCategories: Drinking water that is unconfirmed potable, boil/treat/carry-backup, staffed-only, private/conditional, seasonal or absent from WST drinking-water places.
Fireplaces and grills where reserve rules, fire bans, old bridges/rafts or local signage may prohibit use.
Campsites/tenting claims inside reserves where no-camping, designated-place or no-fire rules apply.
Remote endpoint access and sparse transit in Stages 18-24, especially Vaktarekullen, Flotemarkson, Porsas and Nornas corridor.
Bridge, raft, forestry, windfall and planned-burn currentness around Stages 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 16 and 18-20.

Coordinate-review clusters noted in progress, including Stora Hassungaredssjon/Stage 1, Stenshult/Stage 12, Saveleken/Stage 19, Kasebo/Stage 20, Bjornerodspiggen/Stage 26 and endpoint service clusters in Stromstad/Stage 27.

protectedAreas: Run final GIS line-buffer overlay before generating public protected-area or Natura 2000 warnings.
Use section rulesAndSafety for candidate warnings, but keep nearby/context-only areas out of route spans until overlay confirms intersection.
Kynnefjall reserve stages need designated-place-only fire/tenting handling where section files require it.
waterProtection: Assign water-protection warnings only after final GIS overlay confirms exact subsegments.
Do not present natural water as potable; add contamination/washing/waste/toileting cautions where section files call for them.
fire: Use established fireplaces only where imported and current rules allow.
Fire bans can prohibit all open fire, including prepared fireplaces.
Live-check krisinformation.se, county/municipality or rescue service before publication.
dogs: Carry West Sweden Trails guidance that dogs require extra strict supervision 1 March-20 August and should be kept as strictly as if on a physical leash within one meter.
Reserve, pasture, cattle/horse and local leash rules override generic guidance.
camping: Do not present stages as generally tent-friendly when WST campsite category returned no items or reserve rules constrain camping.
Encode no-camping/designated-place/prepared-campsite limits exactly from section files and final GIS overlay.
liveChecksBeforePublication: WST status/deviation widgets and Naturkartan/current route notes
Vasttrafik timetables, Nartrafik eligibility and replacement-bus notices
Commercial/private opening hours and seasonal water/toilet/service availability
Bridge, raft, forestry, windfall, planned-burn and storm-damage notices

importOrder.notes: Use mapdata/sections/*.geojson; exclude Stage 21 from complete-route import.
Stop before the Stage 8-to-Stage 9 Bottenstugan gap and decide snap policy.
Import as full official geometry with section caveats; stop at Stage 21 start.
Import as a separate chain unless Stage 21 partial/self-navigation policy is approved.
Do not import as complete route. Only proceed if authoritative full route geometry is obtained or the app deliberately supports partial/self-navigation metadata.
Run cluster dedupe, pending/suppress filtering, GIS overlays and live checks before user-facing publication.

hardBlockers: Stage 21 remains partial official geometry only and must not be imported as a complete route.
Runtime integration still needs a separate explicit import task.
A deliberate decision is required before any Stage 21 partial/self-navigation route model is represented.
Do not bridge, snap or auto-route the 4.296 km Stage 21-to-Stage 22 gap.
publicationTimeRechecks: WST status/deviation widgets, fire bans, transit timetables, commercial opening hours and seasonal services.
Final GIS line-buffer overlays for protected areas, water-protection zones and restriction subsegments.
Facility coordinate verification where section files mark records pending, approximate or conflicting.

openDecisionsForUser: Exclude Stage 21 entirely from route import, request authoritative full geometry from Tanum municipality/WST, or implement an explicit partial/self-navigation model.
Choose snap policy for the 49.4 m Stage 8-to-Stage 9 Bottenstugan gap.
Choose whether Bohusleden is represented as one chain with an explicit Stage 21 gap or as separate importable chains around Stage 21.
Choose side-service/access metadata radius and visibility for remote northern endpoints and town service clusters.
Choose how pending OSM-only fire/water/shelter/picnic candidates are stored before verification.
Choose warning granularity for reserve, water-protection, dog, fire and camping rules after GIS overlay.

Review the 49.4 m Stage 8-to-Stage 9 gap before route-chain import.
Review the 4296.3 m Stage 21-to-Stage 22 gap and keep it explicit.
Compare official distances, computed distances and source contradictions before exposing distances.
Run facility cluster/dedupe pass and verify pending/OSM-only/private/seasonal records before import.
